crossRefs.note: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the…

translations.web: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.
translations.bsb: One night both the chief baker and I had dreams, and each dream had its own meaning.
translations.kjv: And we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
translations.asv: and we dreamed a dream in one night, I and he; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
